# Xorg XKB view of SetModifierMapping (issue #171): Xvfb -noreset, fresh server per case
# server: X.Org version 21.1.24 (xdpyinfo); `Xvfb -version` -> "Unrecognized option: -version" (not supported by this build)
# pacman -Q: xkeyboard-config 2.48-1 xorg-server-xvfb 21.1.24-1
# each case: setxkbmap -rules evdev -model pc105 -layout L; then tools/xkb-mutation-probe.c
# output grammar as in xorg-xkb-change-keyboard-mapping.txt, plus:
#   > smm:KPM:KC,...     SetModifierMapping with exactly these keycodes
#   > smmx:EDITS         SetModifierMapping built from the current GetModifierMapping with EDITS
#                        (same | -KC@MOD | +KC@MOD | kpm=N); 'sent kpm=K keys=...' is the request sent
#   = status=S           reply: 0 Success, 1 Busy, 2 Failed; '= error=...' for protocol errors
#   > down:KC / up:KC    XTEST FakeInput key press/release on the actor
#   > run:CMD            an external client acts (exit status recorded)
# 'down:24 up:24' warms XTEST up first where keys are held: the first XTEST event makes the XTEST
# keyboard the core keyboard's last slave, which itself sends NewKeyboardNotify/MappingNotify.
# The xmodmap-replay case replays, one by one, the mutating requests of
#   xmodmap -e 'remove Lock = Caps_Lock' -e 'keycode 66 = Control_L' -e 'add Control = Control_L'
# as captured with x11trace -n (request list per layout below). NB x11trace prints the request
# length in words as ChangeKeyboardMapping 'keycode-count'; the real count is nsyms/kpk.
# xmodmap-direct runs that xmodmap command itself against the server.
#
# xmodmap requests, layout=gb (seq bytes request):
#   0001    20 Request(98): QueryExtension name='BIG-REQUESTS'
